### 2. Core Services

#### Database & Persistence
- **`lib/data/services/isar_database_service.dart`** - Isar database manager
  - Initialize/close database
  - CRUD for all entities
  - Query by message/chat/URL

#### Media Caching
- **`lib/data/services/media_cache_manager.dart`** - Cache orchestrator
  - Image/audio/video caching
  - 2 GB quota with LRU cleanup
  - Expiration management
  - Cache statistics

#### Upload Management
- **`lib/data/services/upload_queue.dart`** - Priority queue implementation
- **`lib/data/services/upload_manager.dart`** - Upload orchestrator
  - Queue management
  - Retry logic (2s, 5s, 10s backoff)
  - Progress tracking
  - Database persistence

#### Background Processing
- **`lib/data/services/background_upload_service.dart`** - Background uploads
  - Independent from UI lifecycle
  - Periodic queue processing
  - Pause/resume capability
  - Heartbeat monitoring

#### Instant Preview
- **`lib/data/services/instant_preview_service.dart`** - Instant message display
  - Message appears immediately
  - Upload queued asynchronously
  - Status transitions
  - Progress observables

#### Failure Recovery
- **`lib/data/services/upload_recovery_manager.dart`** - Recovery coordinator
  - Automatic retry tracking
  - User-friendly error messages
  - Manual retry interface
  - Cancel/delete operations

#### Connectivity
- **`lib/data/services/connectivity_monitor.dart`** - Connectivity monitoring
  - Real-time status tracking
  - Auto pause/resume uploads
  - Offline state management
  - Recovery on reconnection

#### Initialization
- **`lib/data/services/media_services_initializer.dart`** - Master initializer
  - Initializes all services in order
  - Provides service locator
  - Handles disposal
  - Initialization summary

#### Export Index
- **`lib/data/services/media_services.dart`** - Barrel file
  - Centralized exports
  - Easy importing

## 🚀 Quick Start

### 1. Generate Code
```bash
cd F:\ProgrammingProjects\Talkmate-AI
flutter pub run build_runner build
```

### 2. Update Main
```dart
// Add to main()
final mediaInitializer = MediaServicesInitializer();
await mediaInitializer.initialize();
```

### 3. Import Services
```dart
import 'package:talkmate_ai/data/services/media_services.dart';
```

### 4. Use in UI
```dart
// Instant preview
final preview = Get.find<MediaServicesInitializer>().previewService;
final message = await preview.createInstantPreviewMessage(...);

// Media gallery
Navigator.push(context, PageRouteBuilder(
  pageBuilder: (context, _, __) => MediaGalleryScreen(
    images: mediaMessages,
    initialIndex: 0,
  ),
));

// Voice queue
final voice = Get.find<VoicePlaybackController>();
await voice.buildQueueFrom(
  messages: allMessages,
  selectedMessage: tappedMessage,
);
```

## 🔧 Key Components

### Service Hierarchy
```
MediaServicesInitializer (Master)
├── IsarDatabaseService
├── MediaCacheManager
├── BackgroundUploadService
│   └── UploadManager
├── UploadRecoveryManager
├── InstantPreviewService
├── ConnectivityMonitor
│   └── OfflineUploadRecovery
└── AudioQueueManager
```

### Message Status Flow
```
LOCAL → UPLOADING → UPLOADED → PENDING → SENT → DELIVERED → READ
          ↓ (failure)
       FAILED → (retry) → UPLOADING ...
```

### Upload Retry Policy
```
Attempt 1: Wait 2 seconds
Attempt 2: Wait 5 seconds
Attempt 3: Wait 10 seconds
After 3: Failed state, show user options
```
